Mifepristone and misoprostol for medical management of early pregnancy loss (EPL)
Pregnancy type (miscarriage, uncertain viability, unknown location)
outcome: Emergent interventions (uterine aspiration, uterine artery embolization, blood transfusions)
cohort: 72 patients receiving mifepristone and misoprostol for EPL at a single institution
finding: While there was a trend towards lower treatment success in the emergency department compared to the outpatient office, this difference was not statistically significant after adjusting for insurance status and pregnancy type.
